Materials play a significant role in determining your kitchen joinery budget in Dingley Village. For homeowners seeking a premium look, timber veneer, two-pack polyurethane, and solid timber benchtops can increase costs by $5,000 to $15,000 depending on species and thickness. Stone benchtops such as engineered quartz or natural granite are another popular choice among Dingley Village homeowners, adding between $3,000 and $8,000 to the overall budget.
